question: Card four of the vision on jaws-v1: The Queen of Dale (a 2-mana Human; recruits -- loot, and a 1/1 Human Soldier on a nonland discard -- whenever an opponent casts their first noncreature spell each turn) in -- and for what?

contributions.slice: MODE prescribe: the Queen's cut; verbatim (orchestrator notes trimmed)
contributions.text:
My pick is Prince Imrahil the Fair out, The Queen of Dale in. Judged from the cards and the log; no try, net-change, regen or Forge.

1. Prince Imrahil the Fair (pick). He is the one Human in the list CONTEXT.md never names. His job is a 1/1 Human token "whenever you draw your second card each turn"; he does nothing for drawing to grow Shabraz or for discarding to feed Brallin. The Queen does the same job at the same cost ({1}{W} for {W}{U}, both two-mana Humans making white 1/1 Human Soldiers), and each recruit is also a draw (a Shabraz counter and 1 life) and a discard (a Brallin counter and 1 damage to each opponent). She keeps the two-mana creature count at 8 (study 002) — four of six logged losses opened with no board (003, 004, 005, 009). Cost: Imrahil's token is guaranteed and fires on our own turn off any second draw; the Queen's needs a nonland discard and an opponent's first noncreature spell; she is 2/1, not 2/2. Contested: clear on the cards, unmeasured (the goldfish has no opponents casting spells). Not a Game Changer; lands stay 37.
2. Kozilek's Return: works against the Humans-fly board (2 to each creature kills the Queen, Imrahil's tokens, Esper Sentinel, Willie, Inti, Grand Abolisher, Kitsa, Faerie Mastermind), but it is the only sweeper and instant speed; 4 of 9 games ended "raced". Painful; not today.
3. Sokka, Lateral Strategist: three mana, draws only attacking with another creature; a named favourite and a sturdy 2/4 vigilance body. Contested; not recommended.
Ruled out: protection (for the A team) and the wheels (draw-sevens untouchable).
If the pilot does not see Imrahil-for-Queen as a clear upgrade, NO CHANGE is fine: the edge is real but small and comes from a trigger no instrument reads. Study 010's goldfish rows price her as a vanilla 2/1 on an older list — not evidence against her.

call.reading: The Queen of Dale in for Prince Imrahil the Fair: the same two-mana Human token job, and every recruit is also a draw for Shabraz and a discard for Brallin; an argued call -- no instrument reads her trigger.
